metadata.title: How to Choose a Starting Option in Papira | Android Screenshot Guide
metadata.description:
In Papira, choose Create a book for an EPUB with a cover and table of contents, or Convert TXT for an EPUB without a cover or publishing details. Start with a finished TXT manuscript.

Still-screen guide using a real Android emulator screenshot of the app home screen. No taps, conversion, saved result, or speed demonstration is shown. Papira is an EPUB maker, not a manuscript editor or EPUB reader.

Explore Papira for Android:
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.onnellab.papira

#Papira #TXTtoEPUB #EPUBMaker #Shorts
